Marissa / Ben —

Looping you in to finalize the invite cadence and the RSVP link failover plan for the DevOps Inc co-hosted webinar (DevOps engineers audience, Sept 29 preferred). Action items below.

1) Cadence (recommended):
  - Initial partner-branded invite (day 0)
  - Reminder 1 (7 days out)
  - Reminder 2 (3 days out)
  - Day-of reminder (2 hours prior)
  - Post-webinar recording email (1 day after)

2) Tracking + fallback rules (burn-rate mitigation):
  - Primary RSVP: hosted redwood.ai link with UTM parameters.
  - Fallback 1 (after 5xx or link unreachable for >10 mins): redirect to a minimal registration page (no JS tracking) that preserves UTM parameters.
  - Fallback 2 (if registration form fails): display a mailto:sponsorships@devops-inc.com fallback with prefilled subject and UTM in body.
  - Monitor RSVP conversion hourly for first 48 hours. If cohort CTR->RSVP drops >30% vs. baseline, trigger link rotation schedule and pause the current send batch.

3) Link rotation plan: rotate tracking query param sets every 12 hours for the first 72 hours to isolate attribution anomalies; schedule in link-rotation-schedule.csv (attached).

4) Reporting hooks: push raw RSVP events to our internal events endpoint + HubSpot company DEVOPS-6789. Ensure the fallback registration page posts to the same sink or adds a fallback tag.

5) Assets we need from Elena: speaker bio, headshot, company logo (SVG), and any partner landing page URL.

Elena – can you confirm that your portal supports prefilled UTM passthrough for fallback so we don't lose source attribution?

Marissa / Ben — can you review the failover sequence and confirm who owns hourly monitoring + who will execute pause + rotate? I can set up a short runbook doc once we lock owners.

Thanks,
Rafael

[attachment: link-rotation-schedule.csv]
